title: Mini-case: e-bike sharing in European cities
text: E-bike sharing operators rent bikes by the minute via an app. Bikes are bought from three large Asian manufacturers; parking permits are granted by cities, which increasingly limit the number of operators. Users compare prices across apps in seconds; public transport, e-scooters, private bikes and walking are alternatives. Many operators raised venture capital and compete on price; some have gone bankrupt.

title: Mini-case: a European car-parts supplier
text: A German supplier of exhaust systems for combustion-engine cars wants to understand its macro-environment for the next ten years.

title: Mini-case: streaming music
text: A consultant concludes: “The music-streaming industry grows 10 % a year, so it is very attractive.” The three largest labels own most of the music catalogue; users switch between Spotify, Apple Music and others easily; Apple, Amazon and Google bundle music with other services.
